stop.reaction: I am stopping on the phone after about 70 seconds. People gave me small private stories right away and betrayal had a visible cost, which I liked. But the game chose who I told and what I said, Ece would not talk with no reason, and the record is a long wall of text. I have seen the loop and want to try desktop.

Stopping on desktop after about 75 seconds. Private stories arrive fast and refusals have reasons in the record, which I liked. But Rıza and Osman gave the same stories as on the phone, refusals only show in the long record, and I have seen the loop. I would come back another evening to see Day 2, not leave it running.
